_comment: Hero shot list. compose_prompt() in scripts/falgen.py builds each final prompt as: STYLE + BEHAVIOUR + locks[] + ATTACHMENT NOTE for assets[] + ACTION + CAMERA + SFX. The SFX line is an input that times the picture; the returned audio is discarded.

shots.action: Wide hedgerow in late autumn. Overcast, thin ground fog, wet leaf litter. Wind moves the bramble. Nothing else happens. No animal enters the frame at any point.
shots.camera: Locked off on a heavy tripod, long lens. Completely static for the full duration. No reframe, no push, no pan.
shots.sfx: Wind in dry hawthorn, water dripping from leaves, a rook calling twice at distance.

shots.action: Wet leaf litter and the base of a bramble stem. Empty. A single dry leaf shifts in the wind. Nothing arrives, nothing lands, nothing is visible.
shots.camera: Locked off at ground level, long lens, background compressed to unreadable bokeh, very shallow focus.
shots.sfx: Close wind in leaf litter, and one brief wingbeat flutter somewhere off-frame that is never sourced.

shots.action: Slow pan right across bramble and hawthorn. Empty throughout. The pan LAGS - it arrives late at each part of the hedge, as though following something it cannot keep up with. It ends on an empty twig.
shots.camera: Slow deliberate tripod pan right, lagging and slightly imprecise, ending on empty twig. Human operator hesitation.
shots.sfx: Tripod head friction, wind, the same unsourced flutter, now away to the right.

shots.action: Background twigs held in sharp focus. A soft pale OUT-OF-FOCUS form drifts through the extreme foreground at bottom-left and exits frame left. It is never identifiable and never resolves. Focus never changes to follow it.
shots.camera: Locked off. Focus stays on the background for the entire shot. The operator does not react and does not refocus.
shots.sfx: A single close wingbeat, very brief, passing to the left.
shots.note: The flagship effect. If the model centres or focuses the moth, discard and re-run - do not accept a beautiful macro moth.

shots.action: Rack focus from a mid-ground twig to a nearer twig. Both are completely empty. Wet bark, a trembling leaf. Nothing on either twig.
shots.camera: Locked off, one deliberate focus pull mid-shot with a slight overshoot and correction - a human hand on the lens barrel.
shots.sfx: Lens barrel friction, wind, no wings.

shots.action: At the extreme RIGHT EDGE of frame, a partially cropped pale wing edge rests against a stem, bisected by the frame line, mostly out of frame and soft. It does not move. The rest of the frame is empty hedgerow in focus.
shots.camera: Locked off. No reframe toward it. The framing is never corrected.
shots.sfx: Wind only. The absence of any wing sound is deliberate.

shots.action: Empty leaf litter again, marginally different framing from the earlier plate, last light. Nothing in frame.
shots.camera: Locked off, long lens, static.
shots.sfx: Wind dropping, distant rook.

shots.action: Heavy grey sea. A broad black back breaks the surface moving frame-left to frame-right, blows - the distinctive V-shaped spout of a right whale - and begins to submerge on the same axis. Cold flat light, wind-torn spray.
shots.camera: Long lens from a vessel to the animal's left flank. Handheld weight but not shaky, sea motion under the operator, slight lag behind the animal.
shots.sfx: Wind across the microphone, swell against a hull, the low wet exhalation of the blow.

shots.action: Long lens detail of the rostrum, water streaming off the white callosity pattern - one large patch above the lip, two isolated islands behind the blowholes, one crescent over the right eye. Cold grey light.
shots.camera: Locked long lens, very shallow focus on the callosity pattern, sea moving beneath the operator.
shots.sfx: Water sheeting off skin, swell.
shots.note: Held in silence in the edit - no VO over this shot. The pattern has to read clearly enough that the audience can compare it to shot10.

shots.action: Clearer blue-green water, low golden morning sun, faint snow-capped range on the horizon. A broad black back breaks the surface moving frame-left to frame-right, blows, submerges. Identical action to the earlier surfacing, entirely different ocean.
shots.camera: Matched exactly to the North Atlantic surfacing - same lens, same left-flank axis, same lag, same height.
shots.sfx: Calmer swell, warmer air, the same low exhalation.

conditioning.note: match motion and framing, change location only

shots.action: The rostrum again, water streaming off it. The same callosity pattern - one large patch above the lip, two isolated islands behind the blowholes, one crescent over the right eye - now in warm morning light.
shots.camera: Matched exactly to the earlier callosity detail shot.
shots.sfx: Water sheeting, calmer sea.

shots.action: Empty sea and horizon. Nothing surfaces at any point during the shot.
shots.camera: Locked long lens on the horizon, sea motion under the operator, no subject.
shots.sfx: Wind, swell, no blow.

shots.action: Empty grey sea, marginally different framing from the previous plate, light beginning to go. Nothing surfaces.
shots.camera: Locked long lens, sea motion under the operator, no subject.
shots.sfx: Wind, swell, nothing else.
shots.note: Exists to give the segment's last two lines somewhere to land. Cutting between two similar empty plates is how a real documentary buys time - never by holding a frozen frame, which wind and water make obvious.

shots.action: A song thrush on the hawthorn branch - the Y-fork with the broken stub on the left limb. Beak open mid-note, throat distended. Almost no movement at all.
shots.camera: Locked off, long lens, static. Treat as a period plate that barely breathes.
shots.sfx: Shellac surface noise, then a single sustained bird note, bandlimited and thin.
shots.note: Generate CLEAN and age entirely in post. Never ask the model for a vintage photograph - it will invent damage that does not match the modern plate.

shots.action: The same branch, the same Y-fork, the same broken stub, in modern broadcast colour. A song thrush mid-note, throat distended. Wet spring hawthorn.
shots.camera: Matched exactly to the 1890 plate - same lens, same framing, same height.
shots.sfx: Clean modern field recording, close hedgerow ambience, a single sustained note at a different pitch to the 1890 note.

conditioning.note: one generated still serves both centuries

shots.action: Wide hedgerow at dusk. The branch is empty. No bird at any point.
shots.camera: Locked off, long lens, static.
shots.sfx: Evening ambience, no birdsong whatsoever.

shots.action: The hedgerow at dusk, tighter than the previous plate, wet leaves. No bird, no movement beyond the wind.
shots.camera: Locked off, long lens, static.
shots.sfx: Evening ambience, wind only, no birdsong.

shots.action: The hedgerow from Specimen 001, wider, at last light. Wet leaf litter, thin fog. Empty. Nothing enters and nothing happens for the entire shot.
shots.camera: Locked off, long lens, static, with one faint involuntary focus hunt mid-shot.
shots.sfx: Wind in dry leaves. No wings, no birds.
shots.note: Must read as the same location as Specimen 001. The film opening and closing on the same empty frame is the whole formal idea.

shots.action: The same hedgerow, marginally tighter, last light almost gone. Empty.
shots.camera: Locked off, long lens, static.
shots.sfx: Wind almost nothing.

shots.action: Identical framing to the previous plate, last light going. Still completely empty.
shots.camera: Locked off, static, no reframe. Held slightly too long.
shots.sfx: Wind dropping to near silence.
